headlines.title: Chet Holmgren Out 8-10 Weeks Due To Patellar Tendon Tear
headlines.wce_line: Chet Holmgren, who ranks in the 75th percentile for Box Plus/Minus, will miss eight to ten weeks due to a patellar tendon tear.

headlines.title: Ja Morant Out At Least Four Weeks With Grade 2 Left Hamstring Strain
headlines.wce_line: Morant's injury could see Jrue Holiday and Damian Lillard handle increased minutes, with Holiday starting alongside Lillard in the guard lineup.

headlines.title: Jeanie Buss accuses siblings of secret plot to oust her from Lakers
headlines.wce_line: The Buss siblings' legal battle over the Los Angeles Lakers could decide Jeanie Buss's future as the team's governor.

headlines.title: Mark Walter, Josh Kushner Finalize All Terms Of $12.5B Lakers Sale
headlines.wce_line: The deal, valued at $12.5 billion, requires final signatures from Mark Walter and Josh Kushner before being reviewed by the NBA.

headlines.title: Jazz spooked on their home floor against Trail Blazers
headlines.wce_line: The Jazz's defensive struggles and lack of offensive cohesion led to a dominant performance by the Trail Blazers early in the fourth quarter.

headlines.title: UConn's Hurley gets 2-year extension, now signed through 2032
headlines.wce_line: Hurley's extension keeps him at UConn through 2031-32, maintaining his status as one of the highest-paid college basketball coaches.

headlines.title: Five-star F Green commits to Alabama after 'priority' push
headlines.wce_line: Green chose Alabama over other top programs like Ole Miss, Oklahoma, and Kansas due to the school's commitment and supportive environment during his recruitment process.

headlines.title: Ochai Agbaji, Thunder Agree To Contract
headlines.wce_line: The signing addresses Oklahoma City's wing depth after recent injuries, bringing in Ochai Agbaji following his release by the Knicks.

headlines.title: Austin Reaves took the blame for the struggles of the second unit vs. Warriors
headlines.wce_line: Reaves acknowledged his poor performance, stating he needs to be better in leading the second unit's chemistry and play.

headlines.title: Kings rookie Darius Acuff Jr. becomes NBA's first teenager to make 9 3-pointers in a game
headlines.wce_line: Darius Acuff Jr.'s nine 3-pointers tied the NBA rookie record, out of 14 attempts.

headlines.title: Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen lead Cavs to runaway victory over Bucks
headlines.wce_line: Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen's combined box plus/minus of 90th and 83rd percentiles, respectively, dominated the paint in the Cavaliers' victory.

headlines.title: Steph Curry drops Luka Doncic — and finds his joy
headlines.wce_line: Steph Curry's defense against Luka Doncic, ranked 65th in rebounds per 75, showcased his dominance even in unexpected areas.

headlines.title: Tyrese Maxey scores 38, Jaylen Brown returns to 76ers' lineup for 109-104 win over Hornets
headlines.wce_line: Jaylen Brown's return contributed 38 points, though he struggled early, scoring just one in the first quarter.

headlines.title: It’s time for Julius Randle and Michael Porter Jr. to be the leaders the Nets need
headlines.wce_line: Randle and Porter must improve their in-game recognition to lead the Nets through adversity, as both struggle with defensive responsibilities despite offensive prowess.

headlines.title: Elly De La Cruz’s Luka Doncic trolling adds twist to Dodgers trade rumors
headlines.wce_line: De La Cruz's support for Curry contrasts with Doncic's performance, which includes league-leading percentiles in points and usage rate.

headlines.title: An exclusive with Kevin Durant: On his time in OKC, his legacy and the Thunder's 2025 title
headlines.wce_line: Kevin Durant's arrival in Oklahoma City in 2008 marked the beginning of an era that included two future MVPs but only one Finals appearance before his departure in 2016.

headlines.title: LeBron James, Joel Embiid Out Saturday Due To Injury Management
headlines.wce_line: The Sixers' key players, James and Embiid, are managing injuries but remain crucial to the team's performance despite their lower box plus/minus ratings this season.

headlines.title: Jaylen Brown, Tacko Fall active, Joel Embiid, LeBron James ruled OUT for Sixers-Hornets
headlines.wce_line: Without key players James and Embiid, the Sixers' bench players like Caldwell-Pope, Wade, and Simons will have more minutes.

headlines.title: Luka Doncic catches unexpected stray in Ayesha Curry’s Warriors flex
headlines.wce_line: Luka Dončić faced a significant reminder of Steph Curry's dominance, catching an unexpected stray from the Curry family on social media.

headlines.title: Reed Sheppard gets paid… well, kind of
headlines.wce_line: Sheppard's box plus-minus of 61st percentile suggests his overall impact on the court is above average but not exceptional.

headlines.title: Watch AJ Dybantsa’s home debut highlights with the Wizards
headlines.wce_line: AJ Dybantsa scored above-average while making his home debut for the Wizards last night.

headlines.title: Collin Gillespie is showing Jalen Green how to run the Suns
headlines.wce_line: Collin Gillespie's 50th percentile Box Plus/Min shows he’s outperforming Jalen Green's 14th percentile in roles crucial for the Suns' defense.

headlines.title: Yaxel Lendeborg admits he ‘wet the bed’ against Luka Doncic
headlines.wce_line: Yaxel Lendeborg, who entered the game at the 71st percentile in usage rate, struggled to keep up with Luka Doncic's 99th percentile performance.

headlines.title: VJ Edgecombe was ready for the moment yet again
headlines.wce_line: Edgecombe's rebounding prowess stands out, ranking in the 75th percentile among NBA players this season.

headlines.title: How can Thunder survive Chet Holmgren's absence? Rookie Aday Mara becomes vital as trade rumors swirl
headlines.wce_line: Aday Mara must significantly improve his box plus/minus to 34th percentile to compensate for Chet Holmgren's absence.

headlines.title: Luka Dončić teaches Yaxel Lendeborg a lesson, but Warriors bail their rookie out in comeback win over Lakers
headlines.wce_line: Lendeborg's minus-20 rating highlighted his struggles against Dončić, showcasing a stark contrast in performance levels.

headlines.title: LeBron James on 5-1 76ers: 'I'm more than happy I made the decision to come here'

headlines.title: Lakers’ Austin Reaves has blunt 4-word response to turnover woes
headlines.wce_line: Reaves finished with 21 points and five assists but committed eight turnovers in the Lakers' loss to the Warriors.

headlines.title: Steph Curry, Draymond Green ruled out for front end of Warriors' back-to-back

headlines.title: LeBron James Has 'Best Game' For Sixers In Win Over Knicks
headlines.wce_line: LeBron James' performance in the win over the Knicks included tying Kareem Abdul-Jabbar for fifth-oldest player to score 20 points in a game at this age.
